<!-- Guidance for the author. Delete these comments before submitting; they stay in
the text even though the page hides them.
- Keep Outcome and context, Scope and constraints, Work breakdown and Success
  criteria; delete Owner and dependencies, heading included, if it would add
  nothing.
- Make the issue understandable on its own. Say each thing once; if it fits several
  sections, choose one.
- Keep implementation detail in the sub-issues or linked design documents.
- Separate agreed scope from ideas that still need a decision. Do not invent
  missing details.
- Use the names found in the code or product, and summarize any source the reader
  cannot open. -->

## Outcome and context
<!-- What should this work achieve, for whom, and why? -->

## Scope and constraints
<!-- What is included, what is outside this effort, and agreed constraints. -->

## Work breakdown
<!-- How the work is tracked, for example "Delivered through the attached
sub-issues." Attach existing issues as sub-issues, and list planned work that has
no issue yet, marked as planned. -->

## Success criteria
<!-- Observable outcomes that complete the epic, as `- [ ]` items. If closing the
sub-issues would not show the outcome was achieved, add a criterion that does. -->

## Owner and dependencies
<!-- Who coordinates the outcome, blocking dependencies, and open decisions. -->
